title: Thus Said Jesus: — "Go and Do
description: Thus Said Jesus: — "Go and Do in Tonic Solfa to PLEYEL'S HYMN, doh is G: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 5 verses and a piano.
about: William Roscoe wrote these words. They were printed in A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion, compiled by Samuel Longfellow and Samuel Johnson (Boston, 1848), as hymn 292, “The Golden Rule”.

The book printed the words without tunes, marked Sevens (7.7.7.7) (7.7.7.7), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to PLEYEL'S HYMN; any other Sevens (7.7.7.7) tune fits them as well.
underlay: Thus said Je-sus: "Go and do As thou wouldst be done un-to:" Here thy per-fect du-ty see, All that God re-quires of thee.

lines: Thus said Jesus: — "Go and do
As thou wouldst be done unto:"
Here thy perfect duty see,
All that God requires of thee.
Wouldst thou, when thy faults are known,
Wish that pardon should be shown?
Be forgiving, then, and do
As thou wouldst be done unto.
Shouldst thou helpless be and poor,
Wouldst thou not for aid implore?
Think of others, then, and be
What thou wouldst they should to thee.
For compassion if thou call,
Be compassionate to all;
If thou wouldst affection find,
Be affectionate and kind.
If thou wouldst obtain the love
Of thy gracious God above,
Then to all His children be
What thou wouldst they should to thee.

source: A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion (1848)
licence: Public domain: William Roscoe died in 1831.
credits: Words by William Roscoe (1753–1831), public domain, as printed in A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion (1848); set to PLEYEL'S HYMN by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
